annotations.target_phrase: I was just passing the time of day with old Troy of the D.M.P.
annotations.annotation_text: Opening of Episode 12 (Cyclops). 5:00 PM. Barney Kiernan's pub on Little Britain Street. Narrated by an unnamed Dublin debt-collector using cynical, vernacular Dublin slang, juxtaposed against 33 hyperbolic parodies written in heroic, Ossianic, legal, and biblical styles ('gigantism').
sources: Gilbert, Stuart. James Joyce's Ulysses. Faber, 1930.
Gifford, Don, and Robert J. Seidman. Ulysses Annotated. UC Press, 1988, p. 314.

annotations.annotation_text: Modeled closely on Michael Cusack (1847–1906), founder of the Gaelic Athletic Association (GAA). The Citizen embodies militant, narrow, and anti-Semitic Irish chauvinism, acting as the one-eyed Cyclops (Polyphemus) who hurls a biscuit-tin at Bloom.
sources: Ellmann, Richard. James Joyce. Oxford UP, 1982.
Kenner, Hugh. Dublin's Joyce. Chatto & Windus, 1955.
